title: Dawn
tagline: View and listen to NFTs with Zora using our user friendly discord bot.
description:
This project displays NFT collections data and individual NFT data in discord with our user friendly discord bot.  One can get any data related to an NFT collection attributes, sales, floor price and much more. Each command is well documented and ready to use. We have integrated the full power of the Zora API in our discord bot and it can fetch a lot of useful data that can be used to view your NFTs and collections with your friends or create your personal server where you can flex your NFTs to your members and build a community around it. It can also be used for public sale events and live data fetching.
           We also have a special feature where one can play any music NFTs in the voice channels. Who needs Hydra or Vexera, eh? XD.
           For minting Editions, Drops and createAsk, setAskPrice, cancelAsk and fillAsk we redirect to our dApp to ensure safe and secure data transactions.
We are cross platform. We support Rinkeby, Ethereum Mainnet, Polygon Mainnet and Mumbai Testnet.
          After successful minting or fillAsk, one can add the NFT to his personal collection using our discord bot which will store the data in a DB and can be fetched to display the data hassle free without needing to type the address and tokenId repeatedly. This is just a temporary solution as we will create a decentralized solution post hackathon.
how_its_made:
We used **Zora Dev Kit ( ZDK )** for fetching  
- aggregateAttributes
- collection
- collections
- collectionStatsAggregate
- events
- floorPrice
- markets
- mints
- nftCount
- ownerCount
- ownersByCount
- sales
- salesVolume
- search
- token
- tokens
We displayed them using appropriate relevant slash commands. We used **discordjs** to build our bot. We used **docusaurus** to document our product mimicing the Zora docs theme. We faced a lot of challenges and brainstormed a lot to bring this product into production. Our product supports **Ethereum Mainnet**.
